note: every entry records what its date means. An announcement, an effective date, a filing and a later retrospective description are four different claims about time, and only the first three were knowable on the day

entries.event: Freddie Mac announces it will stop buying the riskiest subprime mortgages
BNP Paribas suspends redemptions on three funds, citing an inability to value US subprime assets
FOMC cuts the federal funds target by 50bp to 4.75%
JPMorgan Chase agrees to acquire Bear Stearns with Federal Reserve support
FHFA places Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac into conservatorship
Lehman Brothers Holdings files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
The Federal Reserve authorises lending to AIG
The US House rejects the initial TARP legislation; the S&P 500 falls sharply
The Emergency Economic Stabilization Act, creating TARP, is signed
FOMC cuts the target to a 0-0.25% range and signals quantitative easing
The S&P 500 closes at its cycle low of 676.53
The Financial Crisis Inquiry Commission delivers its final report
